classification: Non-scientific renderer cache: PreBakeCache, cache file/texture registries, compiled .pso shaders, ResourceSync cache, CrashReporter metadata. Entire directory is byte-preserved, including metadata; no reconstructibility assertion or content deletion.
original_path_behavior: Directory junction retains the original application path
rollback: With game closed: remove only the source junction; copy destination contents to an ordinary directory at source; verify all manifest SHA256 values before removing destination.
